startMessage.line1: Even knowing I'll burn out later, I still go all-in from the very start... why do I do this?
startMessage.line2: It's only been a few days, but you're already checking in morning and night, booking the perfect restaurant, planning surprise gifts. They're touched, but a few months later you're running on empty, and resentment starts creeping in. Looking at yourself, you wonder, "Why do I always do this?"
startMessage.line3: Everyone overdoes it early on for different reasons. Maybe you want to win their heart first. Maybe you're anxious they'll leave. Maybe you're hoping to get the same back. Maybe you're simply overflowing with excitement. Or maybe you just want to be seen as a good person. How you react reveals who you really are.
startMessage.line4: These 10 scenarios reveal the real reason you go all-in early, and how to find the right pace.
